title: H3K27me2: analysis code for "Histone H3K27 methylation states are sequentially catalyzed in cycling cells"
description:
Analysis code for the manuscript "Histone H3K27 methylation states are sequentially catalyzed in cycling cells" by Greene, Ahmad and Henikoff.

The repository holds the eight publication notebooks that produce the figures, the processing scripts that build the processed data from CUT&Tag sequencing reads, and the conda environments both need.

Related deposits: raw sequencing data are in GEO under GSE327802; processed data are on Zenodo under 10.5281/zenodo.19489947.

The MIT license covers this repository's own work only. It does not cover the two redistributed supplement files under data/2024/LAD_data/, which keep the terms recorded in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
